about.title: Lemoore Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Lemoore's roads carry a steady mix of local traffic, Naval Air Station commuters, and agricultural vehicles, and Kings County's own numbers show that collisions cluster on corridors like N Lemoore Avenue, Rt 41, W Hanford Armona Road, and W Bush Street. Weekend afternoons, especially Saturdays between 3 and 5 p.m., see a noticeable rise in reported crashes. Whether you were rear-ended near a busy intersection or sideswiped while turning onto Bush Street, the aftermath brings medical bills, lost wages, and calls from insurance adjusters who may ask you to give a recorded statement early. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm, and we're built specifically to help injured Lemoore residents get in touch with an independent personal injury attorney quickly. We don't invent promises about outcomes; we simply help you find someone who can evaluate your situation and start protecting your rights, from preserving evidence to handling the insurance conversation on your behalf.
commonInjuries: Torn ligaments or soft tissue damage

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before the Statute of Limitations Passes

items.title: California's Two-Year Clock
items.desc: California generally gives you two years from the crash date to file a personal injury claim, but if a government vehicle or road defect was involved, that window can shrink to as little as six months. Talking to an attorney early helps make sure you don't miss a critical deadline.

items.title: Comparative Fault Still Lets You Recover
items.desc: California follows a pure comparative fault rule, meaning you can still pursue compensation even if you were partly at fault for the crash. An attorney can help gather evidence before it disappears to support your share of the story.

items.title: No Cap on Non-Economic Damages, No Upfront Cost
items.desc: California places no cap on non-economic damages like pain and suffering, and attorneys in our network work on contingency, so there's no fee unless you recover. That structure lets you focus on healing instead of paying for legal help out of pocket.

items.question: Should I give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: It's generally best to avoid giving a recorded statement before speaking with an attorney. Insurance adjusters are trained to ask questions that can be used to minimize your claim later. An independent attorney can advise you on what, if anything, to say.

items.question: What if my accident happened on Rt 41 or another busy Lemoore corridor?
items.answer: Public crash records show corridors like Rt 41, N Lemoore Avenue, and W Hanford Armona Road see a meaningful share of Lemoore's reported collisions. Location alone doesn't determine fault, but it can help an attorney understand traffic patterns and gather relevant evidence, such as nearby camera footage or witness accounts.

items.question: How long do I have to file a claim after a Lemoore car accident?
items.answer: In California, you typically have two years from the date of the crash to file a personal injury lawsuit, though claims involving a government entity can require action within as little as six months. Because evidence and witness memories fade quickly, it's wise to consult an attorney as soon as possible after the accident.
